##### Project general facts

Sky Line by Peace Homes rises as an architectural statement of modern luxury, distinguished by clean contours, cascading green terraces, and an iconic vertical silhouette. The tower's exterior harmonizes natural elements with contemporary aesthetics, creating an elevated urban oasis. Expansive balconies wrapped in lush greenery and panoramic glazing ensure every residence enjoys a seamless indoor-outdoor connection, while the layered faсade gives the building a sculptural, dynamic presence on the skyline.

Inside, Sky Line offers refined residences where elegant design meets functional sophistication. Warm textures, soft color palettes, and high-end contemporary detailing create a calm and inviting atmosphere. Spacious layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and thoughtful lighting enhance the feeling of openness, while premium craftsmanship elevates every corner of the home. Each residence is designed to embody comfort, beauty, and effortless modern living.

The project delivers an exceptional lifestyle through its collection of world-class amenities. Residents can enjoy sky-level experiences including a rooftop lounge and infinity pool, floating cabanas, panoramic glass yoga room, and a dedicated spa with sauna, steam, and jacuzzi. Entertainment spaces such as the 3D/6D cinema room, table games lounge, and sky cinema complement family-friendly features like kids’ pools and play areas. Fitness and leisure are equally prioritized with a fully equipped gym, padel court, jogging track, rooftop garden, and immersive laser-light experiences. Additional conveniences include retail and office spaces with private entrances, multi-level parking, and excellent connectivity to major roads, schools, clinics, and future metro access.

Every residence at Sky Line is crafted with an exceptional standard of quality, showcasing premium materials and refined finishing that elevate the living experience. Soft textures, elegant surfaces, and thoughtfully selected details create a polished, timeless atmosphere. Kitchens come fully equipped with modern fittings and high-quality cabinetry, offering both functionality and sophistication for everyday use. Delivered unfurnished, each home becomes a blank canvas — allowing residents to personalize their space and express their individual style while enjoying the project’s solid foundation of luxury, craftsmanship, and design excellence.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC) is a sprawling and diverse community located in Dubai, offering a multitude of entertainment, leisure, and residential opportunities. This vibrant community is renowned for its wide range of attractions and experiences, making it a unique destination that caters to residents and visitors of all ages.

At the heart of Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC) is its extensive array of world-class entertainment and leisure destinations. The community is home to numerous theme parks, including Dubai Parks and Resorts, which features Legoland, Motiongate, Bollywood Parks, and the immersive waterpark experience of Legoland Water Park. These attractions provide endless fun and entertainment for families, creating memorable experiences for both children and adults alike.

Dubai Land Residence Complex (DLRC) also boasts a variety of sporting facilities and outdoor spaces, catering to the needs of sports enthusiasts and those seeking an active lifestyle. The community is home to renowned golf courses, tennis courts, cycling tracks, and expansive parks, providing opportunities for outdoor activities and leisurely pursuits.
